title: High Protein Creamy Beef Pasta
reject_reason: Ground beef in a creamy tomato (cream-cheese + sour-cream) sauce over pasta is the same dinner as live cheesy-beef-and-shells-casserole; prior ruling already rejected the near-identical creamy-beef-and-shells on this identity.
